subject.title: iPhone Continuity Camera `--facing front` always uses rear camera

question: Should macOS camera capture keep `deviceId` as an exact selector when `facing` is also provided for an iPhone Continuity Camera device that reports `position: unspecified`?
rationale: The current implementation treats `deviceId` as exact across platforms, while the issue expects `facing` to select a lens behind one Continuity Camera device; automation cannot choose that compatibility contract without maintainer intent and live AVFoundation proof.

options.title: Preserve exact device IDs pending live proof
options.body: Keep `deviceId` exact by default and add a diagnostic or docs limitation unless live proof shows a supported narrow Continuity lens selector.

options.title: Implement Continuity lens selection
options.body: If live AVFoundation proof shows a reliable front/back selector for the same iPhone device, implement that narrow macOS path with tests and docs.

options.title: Let facing override device ID
options.body: Change selector precedence so `facing` can replace an explicit device id, accepting compatibility risk for existing multi-camera users.

recommendation.title: Preserve exact device IDs pending live proof
recommendation.body: Keep `deviceId` exact by default and add a diagnostic or docs limitation unless live proof shows a supported narrow Continuity lens selector.

likelyOwner.reason: The original camera device-selection and adjacent macOS camera history most strongly trace to this owner path.
